skills.summary: Reads and normalizes the BU-wide operational context.
Reads and normalizes narrative/handoff context for one client.
Reads and normalizes Account x GT alignment transcripts.
Parses and normalizes WhatsApp export data for one client.
Visual-first BI reader (CSV parser-driven, PDF visual-only, no OCR) producing normalized metric observations and monitoring candidates.

Range-limited snapshot (values + sparse formulas, real observed_at) of one Google Sheet explicitly declared by the client in sources.json (type google_sheet). Official Sheets API via scripts/lib/google_sheets_transport.py; never searches by name, never writes.
Resolves and loads a client's Quarter plan and optional monitoring.

Promotes validated context/observations into canonical client memory (knowledge.json, strategy.md, current-state.json, decisions.json, history/, evidence.json), preview by default, apply on explicit request. v1.1.0: hash-bound preview (base_state_hash, preview_hash, mutation_plan) and an apply gate bound to an approval record with stale detection (scripts/lib/memory_promotion.py).

Previews/applies evidence-backed observations to an existing Quarter's monitoring.json. v1.1.0 adds a preview-only evidence_overlay to evaluate operations against evidence proposed by an upstream ACTION preview not yet in the canonical ledger; apply always requires canonical evidence.

Quarter lifecycle ACTION: create_quarter (writes an active plan.json from an explicit plan input; never converts seasonal drafts, never creates check-ins/tasks; blocks while another Quarter is active) and close_quarter (requires an ended period and a completed ROPRE, flips the plan to closed, writes closure.json listing carry_over_candidates without completing tasks, resolving operations or creating the next Quarter). Hash-bound preview, approval-gated atomic apply, receipt (scripts/lib/quarter_lifecycle.py).

Previews/applies explicit, evidence-backed changes to one client's longitudinal task ledger. v1.1.0: link_ekyte optionally also sets the additive external.* binding (schemas/task-ledger.schema.json), backward compatible with url-only usage.
Assembles a read-only, evidence-traceable weekly ROPRE draft for a resolved Quarter.
Previews/applies the draft->ready->completed lifecycle for one approved ROPRE check-in.
Consolidates already-normalized SOURCE/canonical outputs for one client into a Context Pack (schemas/context-pack.schema.json). Read-only, never diagnoses.
Diagnoses a client from a Context Pack, distinguishing OBSERVED_ISSUE / OBSERVATION / HYPOTHESIS / MISSING_DATA / RISK explicitly. No numeric health score.
Calculates the gap between current results and SMART target/plan only when mathematically possible — calculable=false never invents current=0.
Ranks operational priorities from diagnosis + gaps using explicit rationale dimensions — no arbitrary numeric score.
Produces a replanning proposal (workstreams + action proposals) from priorities. Never mutates Quarter plan.json.

Connected seasonal plan for one client and any 7–400-day horizon (BR calendar), lazily loaded from that client's context; every element classified FACT/METRIC/CONFIRMED_OPERATIONAL_DECISION/PLANNING_RECOMMENDATION/CLIENT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED/UNKNOWN. Never writes externally or to canonical memory.

Documents ONE creative the operator declared the winner (OPERATOR_DECLARED): objective observations, provided metrics (absent = NOT_AVAILABLE, never zero) plus DERIVED_METRIC ratios, replication hypotheses and do-not-generalize items. Reads only the files named in the brief; no comparison, ranking, benchmark or causal claim without comparative evidence. Optional operator row rule (MAX_RESULTS) picks the metric row of a per-ad export, preserving the original result type and never aggregating rows or resolving ties. Optional ffprobe fills video technical metadata with per-field provenance (operator values never overwritten). Never writes externally or to canonical memory.
Audits a replanning proposal before task generation (unsupported claims, invented deadlines, semantic elevation, etc.). audit_status: fail blocks generate-tasks.

Converts audit-passed replanning actions into task proposals compatible with manage-task-ledger's create_task. Preview only in this MVP — never writes tasks.json itself, never calls manage-task-ledger apply. v1.1.0: task_id is always derived deterministically via scripts/lib/task_identity.py (client_id+quarter_id+action_id), preventing duplicate tasks across repeated replanning runs.

Maps an approved, canonical task to an eKyte-shaped payload and previews/applies publication. Honest capability status: IMPLEMENTED_DRY_RUN — contract, payload mapping, approval gating and idempotency are real and tested (scripts/lib/ekyte_transport.py FakeEkyteTransport); no real eKyte API/connector is documented or available (see docs/workflows/ekyte-publication.md), so real-world apply currently only produces a manual_export packet, never a programmatic publish.

Compares the local task ledger's external bindings against eKyte (via whatever transport is configured) and reports MATCHED/LOCAL_ONLY/STATUS_MISMATCH/DUE_DATE_MISMATCH/UNKNOWN. REMOTE_ONLY is a known, documented limitation of the minimal transport interface (no list_tasks). Never auto-corrects.
Mid-week operational snapshot: planned/completed/pending/overdue/blocked, changed evidence/results, risks, actions needing decision. Never invents execution.
End-of-week operational snapshot: promised vs. executed, blockers, BI movement, SMART evidence, open flags, carry-forward candidates, ROPRE-prep inputs. Never creates carry-over automatically.
Read-only daily briefing reconstructed from canonical operational state.
Read-only call preparation from the selected client's canonical records.
Preview-only post-call normalization and canonical diff; never applies.
Preview-only idempotent discovery of private source revisions.
Read-only semantic change comparison which ignores generated timestamps.
Persists operator decisions that remain pending between proposal and later task materialization or separately authorized external execution. It never replaces tasks.json or executes a transport.

Previews/applies a previously prepared cell-content patch (schemas/google-sheet-patch.schema.json) to one client's declared, writable Google Sheet. Preview never writes; apply requires explicit hash-locked approval, re-reads and aborts on drift, writes content only (values.batchUpdate), never overwrites a formula without replace_existing_formula, then verifies targets, formulas outside the patch and formatting. Replays are no_change. Never decides content.
